verdict: APPROVE the isolated trackpad host revision for later application with a concrete, reviewed T1 packet. The opt-in is exact and exclusive, layered only on the sealed native-only desktop mode, mutually exclusive with the DART survey (field and member), and adds 'pdm1trackpadenum=1' only when the gate passes. One gate serves both the pre-reboot verification and the worker. Every existing packet keeps its previous gates and boot arguments.
verified: trackpad_enumeration_enabled parses the build record with object_pairs_hook=image.unique (duplicate keys refused) and returns False when 'trackpad_enumeration_experiment' is absent. If present, it must equal {version 1, driver 'PDM1SPIHID', interface 2, mode 'enumeration_only', feature_writes false, diagnostic_property 'PDM1TrackpadEnumerationV1'}, with type checks (int version and interface, so a boolean interface is refused; bool feature_writes). It then requires no 'dart_survey_experiment' key, native_keyboard_desktop_enabled(inputs) (the exact native opt-in, no keyboard/virtual/terminal keys, desktop opt-in, bound RAM, PDM1SPIHID/IOHIDFamily/IOGOP present, PDSerialHID absent, exactly one raw PDM1SPIHID entry), and 'org.puredarwin.driver.PDDARTSurvey' absent from the inspected KC members.

Single gate: verify_inputs (the pre-reboot controller check) calls it after dart_survey_enabled, and the worker's guest_bootargs calls it. guest_bootargs = BOOTARGS + ' pdm1kbd=1' (keyboard or native) + ' pddartsurvey=1' (survey) + ' pdm1trackpadenum=1' (trackpad). Survey and trackpad are mutually exclusive, so at most one experiment token is appended. Every non-trackpad string is byte-identical to 25694c88's.

Offline on real packets (scratch replay of eebf8bb8): dart-survey-candidate-001 is native + survey with ' pdm1kbd=1 pddartsurvey=1'; native-startup-001 and native-live-001 are native with ' pdm1kbd=1'; candidate-011 and candidate-009 are terminal with no suffix. Trackpad is false for all five.

In-memory variants of real build records (no packet modified): native001 plus the exact experiment gives native and trackpad true and ' pdm1kbd=1 pdm1trackpadenum=1'. Refused: feature_writes true; boolean interface; any dart_survey_experiment key; the survey KC with only the trackpad field (survey member present); terminal-mode 011 (not native).

Suites rerun on the replay: test_trackpad_enumeration_progress 6/6, test_dart_survey_progress 6/6, test_native_desktop_progress 7/7, test_host_progress 41/41, test_terminal_input_progress 11/11, test_virtual_input_progress 18/18, test_progress_source_fidelity 2/2, all OK.

notes.text: The host binds the driver by name and count only. The concrete T1 packet review must show that the KC's PDM1SPIHID is the T1 adapter SDK output (adapter set 0adea136, /nix/store/1pc572bd...), not keyboard005. Both mismatches fail closed: keyboard005 with the experiment ignores the boot argument, so no PDM1TrackpadEnumerationV1 appears and the collector fails; the T1 adapter without the experiment never probes, so there is no keyboard and the inventory is BLOCKED 77.

The supervisor must not treat a missing PDM1TrackpadEnumerationV1 as success. The trackpad collector and schema are frozen separately (Grok's review). Root's 556-byte V1 layout and the adapter's preservation on every path are the contract.
